how: Manual test on Giovanni's laptop (KDE Plasma, Wayland, layer-shell, 1920x1080) with a virtual pointer through /dev/uinput; every value below was observed, then turned into an automated check in desktop_e2e.rs.

observed.edit_mode_toolbar: floating at top centre with Done, Cancel and Add widget
observed.docked_tray_stays_on_screen: after a widget is moved right the docked tray slides back so its header buttons remain on screen
observed.sticky: not part of the 2026-11-02 manual pass; recorded from the unit tests and the first automated run: a border within 10 px of another widget settles exactly one gap (config.gap, default 10) from it, and a size within 10 px of another widget's becomes that size

limits.warm_up_note: A fresh state directory makes the collector read every transcript first (about 37% of one core for roughly half a minute); idle cost is measured after it settles.

open_findings: Idle CPU of panel plus collector is about 1.3% of one core against the 1% target of SQ-23; cause not found (DESIGN.md section 5)

token_controls_from_widget_top_left.note: observed at the manual test: 7d at (989,214) and Cumulative at (943,240) for a widget whose top-left was (923,166)

resolved_findings: Edit tray ignores the Lock widget layout setting -> the button is disabled while locked (unit test; this test seeds an unlocked configuration)
A widget added to a docked free tray stacked below the screen -> it now gets an explicit rectangle at the top-left corner (checked here)
SIGTERM noticed late by the layer host -> the exit flag is polled every 200 ms (stop time checked here)
A first-run tray taller than its surface froze widgets below the screen edge -> the frozen layout is compressed to fit (checked here)
